heatThresholdC.page: Table 2 p. 590, row 'Dry bean', column Tfp, entry '32 (yield)'; text p. 588 and p. 593
heatThresholdC.note: Tfp = failure-point temperature at which yield fails to zero (Luo p. 584). Cited to Prasad et al. 2002 and Laing et al. 1984. Text p. 593: high temperature (32/27 C day/night) shortly before and at anthesis reduced pod set and seed set substantially (Gross and Kigel 1994); pollen production per flower reduced above 31/21 C and pollen viability dramatically reduced above 34/24 C (Prasad et al. 2002). Day vs mean basis of the 32 C is not stated in the table.
